notes.title: Windows Mixed Reality Support!!
notes.notes:
[h1]We're back with some updates![/h1]

What have we added?
[list]
[*]Windows Mixed Reality support is now integrated!
[/list]

What have we fixed?
[list]
[*]Steam achievements are fixed now!
[/list]

What have we tweaked?
[list]
[*]We made some adjustments to Level 37 after we noticed a lot of players had a very difficult time completing it.
[/list]

What are we doing next?
[list]
[*]That's a secret! Ssshh.
[/list]

notes.title: Bouncing Back With Some Updates
notes.notes:
Howdy, folks! It's been a minute, huh? Well, you'll all be excited to know that we've got a few things coming your way very very soon for Bounce!

What are we planning, exactly? Well, since World Domination is a tricky task, we figured we'd do a little bit of this in the meantime:

[h1]Windows Mixed Reality Support[/h1]

Wow! We're doing the thing! We're adding support for those of y'all with Windows Mixed Reality headsets! 

[h1]Achievement Fixes[/h1]

There's a few fixes we've been meaning to make to our achievements system. The duct tape and bubble gum is being replaced with shiny, shiny metal pipes and other doo-dads to spruce the place up a bit. 

[h1]Level Tweaks[/h1]

Nothing too big here, but there's a few level tweaks we're going to be adding. Level 37 is maybe... maybe a bit [i]too[/i] challenging, you know what I mean? A tiny bit of housekeeping.

[h1]Mystery Updates[/h1]

Nothing to see here. Just some mystery updates. We can't tell you what they are yet. It's a surprise! But a good surprise! And what kind of jerks would we be if we ruined a good surprise, huh? Ssshhh. Be patient.  

[h1]When!?[/h1]

SOON.

Very soon.

Just you wait. 

You'll see.

notes.title: CHEAT CODE REVEALED - ACCESS ALL 50 LEVELS
notes.notes:
Hey all, 
We've been tracking player stats and have decided to reveal a code which will unlock all 50 levels.  

When designing the game, our concept was to learn the basics in constrictive, generic looking room-scale spaces. Over the course of the game, the small rooms would open up into warehouse sized puzzles with lasers, moving obstacles, etc. However, few people have played all the way through level 50 and experienced our favorite content. So, feel free to use these codes and check out everything the game has to offer! 

Type the following code on your keyboard and hit enter. 

15987 - Unlock all levels. (use the keypad)

Good luck with the 40s! 
Bwaa haha haaaa!


-jtop

notes.title: PATCH 1.3 - BOUNCE now supports the Oculus Touch!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone!

Bounce now supports the Oculus Touch. In today's patch, the following features have been added for Oculus Touch players:

[list]
[*]An Oculus Touch specific tutorial has been added. 
[*]New crouch controls added.
[*]New 15 degree rotation controls added.
[*]New teleport facing controls added.
[/list]

In other news, we've started working the convention circuit. Recently, we used a private meeting space at GDC and had a full booth at the San Jose SVVR. Next up, we'll have a booth at the Silicon Valley Comic Con from Friday April 21 to Sunday April 23 2017.

We'll be showing off [b]Mars: Odyssey[/b] and [b]Bounce[/b] next to the Space Village. 



-jtop

notes.title: Bounce Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Happy 2017!!!
We released a patch for Bounce today. 

[list]
[*]The leaderboards have been updated to retrieve information faster.
[*]A "Delete Save Game" function has been added to the Hub. NOTE: If you delete the game you currently have loaded, you will automatically jump to the tutorial. 
[*]Holiday cheer has come and gone. It shall return to the Hub next year!
[/list]

notes.title: Bounce Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1] [b] First Patch is Live! [/b] [/h1]

[list]
[*] Level Complete screen is now located on the left controller and no longer over the exit point. No longer need to worry about gadgets clipping through the menu!

[*] Adjusted SFX to level 50.

[*] Slight level adjustments for level 21.

[*] Adjustments to the Hub Room level select menu.
  
[*] Added a little Holiday cheer to the Hub room!
[/list]

notes.title: BOUNCE IS ONE WEEK OLD!!!
notes.notes:
Happy Birthday, D1g-B. Bounce officially finished it's first week on Steam. According to our Achievement stats, only a handful of people have managed to complete Lvl 50 and join the STYLE MODE leaderboards. 

For those interested in reaching higher "STYLE MODE" leaderboard scores, experiment with the number of gadgets used as well as the travel time and distance of your solutions. Good luck!

ALSO...
This weekend is your last chance to check out the free Bounce demo as it will expire on Monday 12/12. 

Expect to see our first post release patch soon. 

-jtop
